summary.text: Cindy Ledbetter is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 75, which she has represented since November 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A psychiatric nurse practitioner, she faces Democrat Mason Barclay and independent Jim Shields in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Ledbetter lives in Newburgh, Indiana.
She earned an associate degree from Ivy Tech Community College and a B.S. and an M.S. in nursing from the University of Southern Indiana.
Her career experience includes working as a psychiatric nurse practitioner, a director of nursing, a home health long-term care supervisor and a retail manager, and owning a business.
Ledbetter took office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Ron Bacon.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Family, Children and Human Affairs, Insurance, and Public Health committees.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said her priorities include energy affordability and utility reform, access to affordable healthcare, protections for children and families, and improving Indiana's mental health system.
